I am a tenure-track researcher in psychometrics at the [Department of Psychology and Cognitive Science](https://webapps.unitn.it/du/en/Persona/PER0271059/Curriculum) of the University of Trento, in Rovereto.

I work on latent variable models, mostly Item Response Theory: how to shorten a test without losing what it measures, how to generate test items automatically, and how to model accuracy and response times in implicit measures. Most of this ends up as [R packages and Shiny apps](software.qmd), so that other people can use it too.

I am part of the core team of [Psicostat](https://psicostat.dpss.psy.unipd.it/) and an Academic Editor at PeerJ.
